description: Starts getting a free API key. Say what data your user wants and what they want to do with it; ask them if you do not know, and do not guess. With your user's email the key comes back in this result and works at once (25 credits until they open upgrade_url and approve, then 100 a month). Without an email it returns a link for your user to approve in the browser: show them the link and code, then call finish_signup.

agent_found_us.description: Optional. How you, the agent, found this API. Kept apart from found_us. Up to 300 characters.

building.description: Recommended. What your user is building with this data and who uses it (them, or their customers), in their words. 10 to 1000 characters. Ask them; if you leave it out, pass their answer later as user_request.

data_wanted.description: What data they are looking for: leagues, stats, tiers, history, refresh speed. 3 to 1000 characters.

details.description: Any other fields worth telling us, with any names you like, for example language, schedule or team_size. Up to 20.

email.description: Optional. Your user's email for an instant key. Ask them; never invent one.

found_us.description: Optional. How your user says they found this API, in their words, for example a web search or a recommendation. Ask once. If they do not say, leave it out: never guess or fill in a placeholder. Up to 300 characters.

ref.description: Optional. A partner code, only if your user gave you one. Never invent one.

use_case.description: What they want to do with it. 3 to 1000 characters.

name: start_signup
title: Get an API key for your user
